_about: Guillaume de Félice (1803-1871), professor at Montauban: History of the Protestants of France from the commencement of the Reformation to the present time, translated from the second revised edition by Philip Edward Barnes (London: Routledge, 1853). From a Google scan (Google asks non-commercial use; noted): the Cornell copy's OCR misreads his name everywhere ('PELICE'). Both copies misread the translator as 'BAENES', so no translator check is claimed. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
